title: PlantEssentialGenePredictor: versioned models, audited phenotype labels and genome-scale candidate predictions
description: Versioned processed feature matrices, trained models, fixed labels, source-level phenotype audit tables, frozen input checksums, and genome-scale prediction tables associated with PlantEssentialGenePredictor, a plant essential-gene prioritization framework for Arabidopsis thaliana and rice. The audited publication release explicitly separates modelling labels, historical pseudo-labels, phenotype-recorded-but-excluded genes, and true unknown candidates.
